description: This file manages Discord model picker preferences, including reading, writing, and maintaining recent models with locking and normalization.

methods.name: resolvePreferencesStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for storing preferences based on environment variables.

methods.name: normalizeId
methods.description: Trims and normalizes an ID string, returning an empty string if undefined.

methods.name: buildDiscordModelPickerPreferenceKey
methods.description: Builds a unique preference key based on the scope (user, guild, account).

methods.name: normalizeModelRef
methods.description: Normalizes a model reference string, ensuring proper format with provider and model.

methods.name: sanitizeRecentModels
methods.description: Deduplicates and limits the list of recent models.

methods.name: readPreferencesStore
methods.description: Reads the preferences store JSON file with fallback defaults.

methods.name: readDiscordModelPickerRecentModels
methods.description: Retrieves recent models for a given scope, filtered by allowed references.

methods.name: recordDiscordModelPickerRecentModel
methods.description: Records a new recent model for a scope, updating the store with locking.
